sources.title: Cuttack district: District Profile
sources.note: Barabati’s moat, gateway and palace mound beside the Mahanadi. The description of a nine-storeyed palace concerns the lost building; it is not a surviving structure.

sources.title: Bibhudutta Baral and Hariharasudan T., NID Bengaluru: Silver Filigree — Making Process
sources.note: Documents wire drawing, thicker frames, fine-wire infill, joining and finishing. This process account does not establish the craft’s origin or the maker and metal content of the photographed jewellery.

sources.title: Incredible India: Netaji Birth Place Museum
sources.note: Cuttack birthplace and biographical collections, including letters and photographs. Check individual exhibit labels for dates and whether an item is an original or a reproduction.

sources.title: Odisha State Maritime Museum: Jobra Workshop
sources.note: The museum’s account of boat and sluice-gate fabrication, workshop machines and the rail-mounted crane. This is industrial history; it does not establish how ancient ocean-going boita were built.

sources.title: Incredible India: Cuttack’s Cuisine
sources.note: The Dahibara Aloodum section describes lentil fritters, yogurt and spicy potato curry. No vendor, origin date or uniform recipe is established here.
